snippet.title: [Maltese's Fluffy Onsen] Release Trailer
snippet.description:
🛁 Run a bathhouse visited by animals!
Maltese's Fluffy Onsen is a relaxing simulation game that you can enjoy while doing other tasks, as it sits at the bottom of your screen. Place baths with different temperatures and rest areas to help a variety of animal friends unwind.

🫡Inspired by Rusty's Retirement.

📌Buy Now!: https://buly.kr/CWtKAMP
📌X: https://x.com/FluffyOnsen
